fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami and Miami Beach civic affairs, including a petition to call an election for a charter board to change Miami’s municipal government and discussion of one-way street traffic policy. Coverage of Miami Beach politics and elections includes criticism and endorsements of candidates, discussion of the city’s purchase of Flamingo Park from the Carl G. Fisher interests, and a warning to voters about provisions in a proposed Miami Beach gas franchise allowing assignment to other corporations. The issue also contains seasonal tourism-themed satire/poetry about winter visitors, society notes and letters to the editor, and substantial entertainment and sports advertising and listings (including greyhound racing and local theatre programs).
